High sulfur grades
volatility was down in 2013 However, change is afoot in 2015 with the implementation of the .1% Emission Control Areas (ECA) in the Baltic, North Sea, and North American coastal waters, which has the potential to reshape the bunker fuel market. Refineries are not expected to produce a .1% 380cst low sulfur bunker fuel oil due to the low margins on the business, and blending does not appear to be an option as it was with 1% low sulfur bunkers. This leaves burning MGO as the immediate alternative.
